title: Charlie's Tweaked Recipes
description: Tweaks and adds new recipes to the game.
body:
![The Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e87d2807640ca699496e74e03126c54921f2b95.png)

**Charlie's Tweaked Recipes is a simple server side mod that not only tweaks some crafting recipes, but adds some too!**



Ever think, "Hey, why does this recipe only give me _ many blocks and not _?"

Well this mod fixes that recipe, AND MORE!



Here's some examples of features this mod includes!

- **Changes trapdoors to craft 6 instead of 2!**
- **Saddle crafting recipe!**
- **Allows you to quickly craft things in minecarts, without previously crafting the minecart!**
 
AND MANY MORE



Have a recipe idea that you think should be added to the mod? Comment, and if it's good, I'll add it!

You can check out my other projects [here](https://modrinth.com/user/TChar1ie)
